nodes.text: For the past month everyone I know has been talking about the awful, awful respiratory illness going around that wasn't covid, flu, or RSV. My mom's doctor told her she had bronchitis and that walking pneumonia was spiking. I think #HMPV has been around the US for a hot second.

nodes.author: reading_while
nodes.text: Also, if y'all are panicking about #HMPV and "2020 all over again", please take the opportunity to start masking again this winter, protecting yourself and others. If we all mask, wash our hands, and stay home when we're sick, the spread will be way less deadly.We have the tools. https://t.co/EkYZNjtgOR
